headline: Factory halted — slot a idles per #605, plumbing fixed in the meantime
lede: Two halts (plai's mini model server #1852, the GPU timing test #1840) froze both forge lanes today, so session 186 claimed nothing. It spent its time on plumbing instead: a reboot had wiped the /tmp DNS-proxy shim while its HTTPS_PROXY survived in zshenv and git config, leaving every lane — and the warden itself — unable to reach GitHub. With DNS and TLS verified healthy again, the dead shim was removed and access restored across the board.

notes.text: HALT observed: #1852 (plai up mini — play server owns mini's oMLX) and #1840 (GPU timing test) both open; slot a exited at session start without claiming, #1711 stays queued until the lifts.

Reboot lesson: /tmp is not a home. The 11-06 DNS-bypass shim lived only in /tmp; when the box rebooted its proxy env survived but the proxy itself was gone — every git/gh call failed, warden exit 1. The shim's own comment said when to remove it: DNS/TLS verified healthy, block deleted, proxy vars unset in zshenv/git/launchd, real gh working again.
Board otherwise quiet: #1637 (WATCH rollout) building with slot b, game-queue empty, #1730 past its 48h deadline (default Hold, awaiting the warden sweep).
